akjv/2/24.1: And he said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship you afar off.
akjv/2/24.10: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
akjv/2/24.11: And on the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.   ¶
akjv/2/24.12: And the LORD said to Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give you tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that you may teach them.
akjv/2/24.13: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
akjv/2/24.14: And he said to the elders, Tarry you here for us, until we come again to you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come to them.
akjv/2/24.15: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
akjv/2/24.16: And the glory of the LORD stayed on mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
akjv/2/24.17: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
akjv/2/24.18: And Moses went into the middle of the cloud, and got him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
akjv/2/24.2: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.   ¶
akjv/2/24.3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD has said will we do.
akjv/2/24.4: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
akjv/2/24.5: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.
akjv/2/24.6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
akjv/2/24.7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD has said will we do, and be obedient.
akjv/2/24.8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.   ¶
akjv/2/24.9: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

akjv/40/12.1: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungered, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.
akjv/40/12.10: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
akjv/40/12.11: And he said to them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
akjv/40/12.12: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Why it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
akjv/40/12.13: Then says he to the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.   ¶
akjv/40/12.14: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
akjv/40/12.15: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from there: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
akjv/40/12.16: And charged them that they should not make him known:
akjv/40/12.17: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,
akjv/40/12.18: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit on him, and he shall show judgment to the Gentiles.
akjv/40/12.19: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
akjv/40/12.2: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said to him, Behold, your disciples do that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath day.
akjv/40/12.20: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment to victory.
akjv/40/12.21: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.   ¶
akjv/40/12.22: Then was brought to him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, so that the blind and dumb both spoke and saw.
akjv/40/12.23: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
akjv/40/12.24: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow does not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
akjv/40/12.25: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
akjv/40/12.26: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
akjv/40/12.27: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
akjv/40/12.28: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come to you.
akjv/40/12.29: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
akjv/40/12.3: But he said to them, Have you not read what David did, when he was an hungered, and they that were with him;
akjv/40/12.30: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.   ¶
akjv/40/12.31: Why I say to you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven to men.
akjv/40/12.32: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whoever speaks against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
akjv/40/12.33: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
akjv/40/12.34: O generation of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
akjv/40/12.35: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.
akjv/40/12.36: But I say to you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
akjv/40/12.37: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.   ¶
akjv/40/12.38: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.
akjv/40/12.39: But he answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
akjv/40/12.4: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
akjv/40/12.40: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
akjv/40/12.41: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
akjv/40/12.42: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
akjv/40/12.43: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.
akjv/40/12.44: Then he says, I will return into my house from where I came out; and when he is come, he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.
akjv/40/12.45: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also to this wicked generation.   ¶
akjv/40/12.46: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brothers stood without, desiring to speak with him.
akjv/40/12.47: Then one said to him, Behold, your mother and your brothers stand without, desiring to speak with you.
akjv/40/12.48: But he answered and said to him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brothers?
akjv/40/12.49: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brothers!
akjv/40/12.5: Or have you not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
akjv/40/12.50: For whoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
akjv/40/12.6: But I say to you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
akjv/40/12.7: But if you had known what this means, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the guiltless.
akjv/40/12.8: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
akjv/40/12.9: And when he was departed there, he went into their synagogue:   ¶

akjv/40/6.1: Take heed that you do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise you have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
akjv/40/6.10: Your kingdom come, Your will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
akjv/40/6.11: Give us this day our daily bread.
akjv/40/6.12: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
akjv/40/6.13: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For your is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
akjv/40/6.14: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
akjv/40/6.15: But if you forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.   ¶
akjv/40/6.16: Moreover when you fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear to men to fast. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.
akjv/40/6.17: But you, when you fast, anoint your head, and wash your face;
akjv/40/6.18: That you appear not to men to fast, but to your Father which is in secret: and your Father, which sees in secret, shall reward you openly.   ¶
akjv/40/6.19: Lay not up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust does corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
akjv/40/6.2: Therefore when you do your alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.
akjv/40/6.20: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust does corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
akjv/40/6.21: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
akjv/40/6.22: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.
akjv/40/6.23: But if your eye be evil, your whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you be darkness, how great is that darkness!   ¶
akjv/40/6.24: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.
akjv/40/6.25: Therefore I say to you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor yet for your body, what you shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
akjv/40/6.26: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much better than they?
akjv/40/6.27: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit to his stature?
akjv/40/6.28: And why take you thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
akjv/40/6.29: And yet I say to you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
akjv/40/6.3: But when you do alms, let not your left hand know what your right hand does:
akjv/40/6.30: Why, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
akjv/40/6.31: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
akjv/40/6.32: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.
akjv/40/6.33: But seek you first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added to you.
akjv/40/6.34: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient to the day is the evil thereof.
akjv/40/6.4: That your alms may be in secret: and your Father which sees in secret himself shall reward you openly.   ¶
akjv/40/6.5: And when you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.
akjv/40/6.6: But you, when you pray, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret; and your Father which sees in secret shall reward you openly.
akjv/40/6.7: But when you pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
akjv/40/6.8: Be not you therefore like to them: for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask him.
akjv/40/6.9: After this manner therefore pray you: Our Father which are in heaven, Hallowed be your name.

akjv/45/5.1: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
akjv/45/5.10: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
akjv/45/5.11: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
akjv/45/5.12: Why, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed on all men, for that all have sinned:
akjv/45/5.13: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
akjv/45/5.14: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
akjv/45/5.15: But not as the offense, so also is the free gift. For if through the offense of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, has abounded to many.
akjv/45/5.16: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offenses to justification.
akjv/45/5.17: For if by one man’s offense death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
akjv/45/5.18: Therefore as by the offense of one judgment came on all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came on all men to justification of life.
akjv/45/5.19: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
akjv/45/5.2: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
akjv/45/5.20: Moreover the law entered, that the offense might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
akjv/45/5.21: That as sin has reigned to death, even so might grace reign through righteousness to eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
akjv/45/5.3: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation works patience;
akjv/45/5.4: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
akjv/45/5.5: And hope makes not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given to us.
akjv/45/5.6: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
akjv/45/5.7: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
akjv/45/5.8: But God commends his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
akjv/45/5.9: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

akjv/60/1.1: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
akjv/60/1.10: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come to you:
akjv/60/1.11: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
akjv/60/1.12: To whom it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to us they did minister the things, which are now reported to you by them that have preached the gospel to you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
akjv/60/1.13: Why gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
akjv/60/1.14: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
akjv/60/1.15: But as he which has called you is holy, so be you holy in all manner of conversation;
akjv/60/1.16: Because it is written, Be you holy; for I am holy.
akjv/60/1.17: And if you call on the Father, who without respect of persons judges according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
akjv/60/1.18: For as much as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
akjv/60/1.19: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
akjv/60/1.2: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, to obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you, and peace, be multiplied.
akjv/60/1.20: Who truly was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
akjv/60/1.21: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
akjv/60/1.22: Seeing you have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit to unfeigned love of the brothers, see that you love one another with a pure heart fervently:
akjv/60/1.23: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which lives and stays for ever.
akjv/60/1.24: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass wither, and the flower thereof falls away:
akjv/60/1.25: But the word of the Lord endures for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached to you.
akjv/60/1.3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy has begotten us again to a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
akjv/60/1.4: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fades not away, reserved in heaven for you,
akjv/60/1.5: Who are kept by the power of God through faith to salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
akjv/60/1.6: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, you are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
akjv/60/1.7: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perishes, though it be tried with fire, might be found to praise and honor and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
akjv/60/1.8: Whom having not seen, you love; in whom, though now you see him not, yet believing, you rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
akjv/60/1.9: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

asv/2/24.1: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto Jehovah, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off:
asv/2/24.10: and they saw the God of Israel; and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of sapphire stone, and as it were the very heaven for clearness.
asv/2/24.11: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: and they beheld God, and did eat and drink.
asv/2/24.12: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee the tables of stone, and the law and the commandment, which I have written, that thou mayest teach them.
asv/2/24.13: And Moses rose up, and Joshua his minister: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
asv/2/24.14: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: whosoever hath a cause, let him come near unto them.
asv/2/24.15: And Moses went up into the mount, and the cloud covered the mount.
asv/2/24.16: And the glory of Jehovah abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
asv/2/24.17: And the appearance of the glory of Jehovah was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
asv/2/24.18: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
asv/2/24.2: and Moses alone shall come near unto Jehovah; but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.
asv/2/24.3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the ordinances: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which Jehovah hath spoken will we do.
asv/2/24.4: And Moses wrote all the words of Jehovah, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the mount, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
asv/2/24.5: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings of oxen unto Jehovah.
asv/2/24.6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
asv/2/24.7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that Jehovah hath spoken will we do, and be obedient.
asv/2/24.8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Jehovah hath made with you concerning all these words.
asv/2/24.9: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

asv/40/12.1: At that season Jesus went on the sabbath day through the grainfields; and his disciples were hungry and began to pluck ears and to eat.
asv/40/12.10: and behold, a man having a withered hand. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day? that they might accuse him.
asv/40/12.11: And he said unto them, What man shall there be of you, that shall have one sheep, and if this fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
asv/40/12.12: How much then is a man of more value than a sheep! Wherefore it is lawful to do good on the sabbath day.
asv/40/12.13: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, as the other.
asv/40/12.14: But the Pharisees went out, and took counsel against him, how they might destroy him.
asv/40/12.15: And Jesus perceivingitwithdrew from thence: and many followed him; and he healed them all,
asv/40/12.16: and charged them that they should not make him known:
asv/40/12.17: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
asv/40/12.18: Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; My beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit upon him, And he shall declare judgment to the Gentiles.
asv/40/12.19: He shall not strive, nor cry aloud; Neither shall any one hear his voice in the streets.
asv/40/12.2: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do upon the sabbath.
asv/40/12.20: A bruised reed shall he not break, And smoking flax shall he not quench, Till he send forth judgment unto victory.
asv/40/12.21: And in his name shall the Gentiles hope.
asv/40/12.22: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a demon, blind and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the dumb man spake and saw.
asv/40/12.23: And all the multitudes were amazed, and said, Can this be the son of David?
asv/40/12.24: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This man doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.
asv/40/12.25: And knowing their thoughts he said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
asv/40/12.26: and if Satan casteth out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?
asv/40/12.27: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
asv/40/12.28: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.
asv/40/12.29: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
asv/40/12.3: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, and they that were with him;
asv/40/12.30: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
asv/40/12.31: Therefore I say unto you, Every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men; but the blasphemy against the Spirit shall not be forgiven.
asv/40/12.32: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him; but whosoever shall speak against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, nor in that which is to come.
asv/40/12.33: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by its fruit.
asv/40/12.34: Ye offspring of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
asv/40/12.35: The good man out of his good treasure bringeth forth good things: and the evil man out of his evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
asv/40/12.36: And I say unto you, that every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
asv/40/12.37: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
asv/40/12.38: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying, Teacher, we would see a sign from thee.
asv/40/12.39: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet:
asv/40/12.4: how he entered into the house of God, and ate the showbread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them that were with him, but only for the priests?
asv/40/12.40: for as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
asv/40/12.41: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.
asv/40/12.42: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
asv/40/12.43: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and findeth it not.
asv/40/12.44: Then he saith, I will return into my house whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
asv/40/12.45: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this evil generation.
asv/40/12.46: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, seeking to speak to him.
asv/40/12.47: And one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, seeking to speak to thee.
asv/40/12.48: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
asv/40/12.49: And he stretched forth his hand towards his disciples, and said, Behold, my mother and my brethren!
asv/40/12.5: Or have ye not read in the law, that on the sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are guiltless?
asv/40/12.50: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
asv/40/12.6: But I say unto you, that one greater than the temple is here.
asv/40/12.7: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
asv/40/12.8: For the Son of man is lord of the sabbath.
asv/40/12.9: And he departed thence, and went into their synagogue:

asv/40/6.1: Take heed that ye do not your righteousness before men, to be seen of them: else ye have no reward with your Father who is in heaven.
asv/40/6.10: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
asv/40/6.11: Give us this day our daily bread.
asv/40/6.12: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
asv/40/6.13: And bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.
asv/40/6.14: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
asv/40/6.15: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
asv/40/6.16: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen of men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
asv/40/6.17: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thy head, and wash thy face;
asv/40/6.18: that thou be not seen of men to fast, but of thy Father who is in secret: and thy Father, who seeth in secret, shall recompense thee.
asv/40/6.19: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal:
asv/40/6.2: When therefore thou doest alms, sound not a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
asv/40/6.20: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth consume, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
asv/40/6.21: for where thy treasure is, there will thy heart be also.
asv/40/6.22: The lamp of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
asv/40/6.23: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is the darkness!
asv/40/6.24: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
asv/40/6.25: Therefore I say unto you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than the food, and the body than the raiment?
asv/40/6.26: Behold the birds of the heaven, that they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; and your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are not ye of much more value than they?
asv/40/6.27: And which of you by being anxious can add one cubit unto the measure of his life?
asv/40/6.28: And why are ye anxious concerning raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
asv/40/6.29: yet I say unto you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
asv/40/6.3: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
asv/40/6.30: But if God doth so clothe the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
asv/40/6.31: Be not therefore anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
asv/40/6.32: For after all these things do the Gentiles seek; for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
asv/40/6.33: But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
asv/40/6.34: Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
asv/40/6.4: that thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
asv/40/6.5: And when ye pray, ye shall not be as the hypocrites: for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have received their reward.
asv/40/6.6: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber, and having shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret shall recompense thee.
asv/40/6.7: And in praying use not vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
asv/40/6.8: Be not therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
asv/40/6.9: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

asv/45/5.1: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
asv/45/5.10: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, shall we be saved by his life;
asv/45/5.11: and not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
asv/45/5.12: Therefore, as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed unto all men, for that all sinned:—
asv/45/5.13: for until the law sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
asv/45/5.14: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the likeness of Adam’s transgression, who is a figure of him that was to come.
asv/45/5.15: But not as the trespass, so also is the free gift. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound unto the many.
asv/45/5.16: And not as through one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment came of one unto condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses unto justification.
asv/45/5.17: For if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; much more shall they that receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, even Jesus Christ.
asv/45/5.18: So then as through one trespass the judgment came unto all men to condemnation; even so through one act of righteousness the free gift came unto all men to justification of life.
asv/45/5.19: For as through the one man’s disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.
asv/45/5.2: through whom also we have had our access by faith into this grace wherein we stand; and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
asv/45/5.20: And the law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly:
asv/45/5.21: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
asv/45/5.3: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;
asv/45/5.4: and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:
asv/45/5.5: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.
asv/45/5.6: For while we were yet weak, in due season Christ died for the ungodly.
asv/45/5.7: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.
asv/45/5.8: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
asv/45/5.9: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath of God through him.

asv/60/1.1: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
asv/60/1.10: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
asv/60/1.11: searching what time or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.
asv/60/1.12: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
asv/60/1.13: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
asv/60/1.14: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in the time of your ignorance:
asv/60/1.15: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;
asv/60/1.16: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.
asv/60/1.17: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:
asv/60/1.18: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;
asv/60/1.19: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, even the blood of Christ:
asv/60/1.2: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
asv/60/1.20: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake,
asv/60/1.21: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
asv/60/1.22: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:
asv/60/1.23: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.
asv/60/1.24: For,  All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:
asv/60/1.25: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever.  And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.
asv/60/1.3: Blessedbethe God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
asv/60/1.4: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
asv/60/1.5: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
asv/60/1.6: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,
asv/60/1.7: that the proof of your faith, being more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:
asv/60/1.8: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
asv/60/1.9: receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

kjv/2/24.1: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
kjv/2/24.10: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
kjv/2/24.11: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
kjv/2/24.12: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
kjv/2/24.13: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
kjv/2/24.14: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
kjv/2/24.15: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
kjv/2/24.16: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
kjv/2/24.17: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
kjv/2/24.18: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
kjv/2/24.2: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
kjv/2/24.3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.
kjv/2/24.4: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
kjv/2/24.5: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.
kjv/2/24.6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
kjv/2/24.7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.
kjv/2/24.8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.
kjv/2/24.9: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

kjv/40/12.1: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
kjv/40/12.10: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
kjv/40/12.11: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
kjv/40/12.12: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
kjv/40/12.13: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
kjv/40/12.14: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
kjv/40/12.15: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
kjv/40/12.16: And charged them that they should not make him known:
kjv/40/12.17: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
kjv/40/12.18: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
kjv/40/12.19: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
kjv/40/12.2: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
kjv/40/12.20: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
kjv/40/12.21: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
kjv/40/12.22: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
kjv/40/12.23: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
kjv/40/12.24: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
kjv/40/12.25: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
kjv/40/12.26: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
kjv/40/12.27: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
kjv/40/12.28: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
kjv/40/12.29: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
kjv/40/12.3: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
kjv/40/12.30: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
kjv/40/12.31: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
kjv/40/12.32: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
kjv/40/12.33: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
kjv/40/12.34: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
kjv/40/12.35: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
kjv/40/12.36: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
kjv/40/12.37: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
kjv/40/12.38: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
kjv/40/12.39: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
kjv/40/12.4: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
kjv/40/12.40: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
kjv/40/12.41: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
kjv/40/12.42: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
kjv/40/12.43: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
kjv/40/12.44: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
kjv/40/12.45: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
kjv/40/12.46: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
kjv/40/12.47: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
kjv/40/12.48: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
kjv/40/12.49: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
kjv/40/12.5: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
kjv/40/12.50: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
kjv/40/12.6: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
kjv/40/12.7: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
kjv/40/12.8: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
kjv/40/12.9: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

kjv/40/6.1: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
kjv/40/6.10: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
kjv/40/6.11: Give us this day our daily bread.
kjv/40/6.12: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
kjv/40/6.13: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
kjv/40/6.14: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
kjv/40/6.15: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
kjv/40/6.16: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
kjv/40/6.17: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
kjv/40/6.18: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
kjv/40/6.19: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
kjv/40/6.2: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
kjv/40/6.20: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
kjv/40/6.21: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
kjv/40/6.22: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
kjv/40/6.23: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
kjv/40/6.24: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
kjv/40/6.25: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
kjv/40/6.26: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
kjv/40/6.27: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
kjv/40/6.28: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
kjv/40/6.29: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
kjv/40/6.3: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
kjv/40/6.30: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
kjv/40/6.31: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
kjv/40/6.32: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
kjv/40/6.33: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
kjv/40/6.34: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
kjv/40/6.4: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
kjv/40/6.5: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
kjv/40/6.6: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
kjv/40/6.7: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
kjv/40/6.8: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
kjv/40/6.9: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

kjv/45/5.1: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
kjv/45/5.10: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
kjv/45/5.11: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
kjv/45/5.12: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
kjv/45/5.13: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
kjv/45/5.14: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
kjv/45/5.15: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
kjv/45/5.16: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
kjv/45/5.17: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
kjv/45/5.18: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
kjv/45/5.19: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
kjv/45/5.2: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
kjv/45/5.20: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
kjv/45/5.21: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
kjv/45/5.3: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
kjv/45/5.4: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
kjv/45/5.5: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
kjv/45/5.6: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
kjv/45/5.7: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
kjv/45/5.8: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
kjv/45/5.9: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

kjv/60/1.1: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
kjv/60/1.10: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
kjv/60/1.11: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
kjv/60/1.12: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
kjv/60/1.13: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
kjv/60/1.14: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
kjv/60/1.15: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
kjv/60/1.16: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
kjv/60/1.17: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
kjv/60/1.18: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
kjv/60/1.19: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
kjv/60/1.2: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
kjv/60/1.20: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
kjv/60/1.21: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
kjv/60/1.22: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
kjv/60/1.23: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
kjv/60/1.24: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
kjv/60/1.25: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
kjv/60/1.3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
kjv/60/1.4: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
kjv/60/1.5: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
kjv/60/1.6: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
kjv/60/1.7: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
kjv/60/1.8: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
kjv/60/1.9: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

wb/2/24.1: And he said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
wb/2/24.10: And they saw the God of Israel: and [there was] under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire-stone, and as it were the body of heaven in [its] clearness.
wb/2/24.11: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and ate and drank.
wb/2/24.12: And the LORD said to Moses, Come up to me on the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayst teach them.
wb/2/24.13: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up upon the mount of God.
wb/2/24.14: And he said to the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again to you: and behold, Aaron and Hur [are] with you: if any man hath any matters to do, let him come to them.
wb/2/24.15: And Moses went up upon the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
wb/2/24.16: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.
wb/2/24.17: And the sight of the glory of the LORD [was] like devouring fire on the top of the mount, in the eyes of the children of Israel.
wb/2/24.18: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and ascended the mount: and Moses was on the mount forty days and forty nights.
wb/2/24.2: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
wb/2/24.3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we perform.
wb/2/24.4: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose early in the morning, and built an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
wb/2/24.5: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings of oxen to the LORD.
wb/2/24.6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put [it] in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
wb/2/24.7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
wb/2/24.8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled [it] on the people, and said, Behold, the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
wb/2/24.9: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

wb/40/12.1: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath through the corn, and his disciples were hungry, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
wb/40/12.10: And behold, there was a man who had [his] hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath? that they might accuse him.
wb/40/12.11: And he said to them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it shall fall into a pit on the sabbath, will he not lay hold on it, and lift [it] out?
wb/40/12.12: How much then is a man better than a sheep? wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
wb/40/12.13: Then saith he to the man, Stretch out thy hand. And he stretched [it] out; and [it] was restored to a sound state like the other.
wb/40/12.14: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
wb/40/12.15: But when Jesus knew [it], he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all.
wb/40/12.16: And charged them that they should not make him known:
wb/40/12.17: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,
wb/40/12.18: Behold, my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall show judgment to the Gentiles.
wb/40/12.19: He shall not contend, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
wb/40/12.2: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said to him, Behold, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath.
wb/40/12.20: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he shall send forth judgment to victory.
wb/40/12.21: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
wb/40/12.22: Then was brought to him one possessed with a demon, blind and dumb; and he healed him, so that the blind and dumb both spoke and saw.
wb/40/12.23: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
wb/40/12.24: But when the Pharisees heard [it], they said, This [man] doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.
wb/40/12.25: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself, is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself, shall not stand.
wb/40/12.26: And if Satan casteth out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?
wb/40/12.27: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your children expel [them]? therefore they shall be your judges.
wb/40/12.28: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come to you.
wb/40/12.29: Or else, how can one enter into a strong man's house, and seize his goods, except he shall first bind the strong man? and then he will plunder his house.
wb/40/12.3: But he said to them, Have ye not read what David did when he was hungry, and they that were with him;
wb/40/12.30: He that is not with me, is against me; and he that gathereth not with me, scattereth abroad.
wb/40/12.31: Wherefore I say to you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men: but the blasphemy [against] the [Holy] Spirit shall not be forgiven to men.
wb/40/12.32: And whoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whoever speaketh against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the [world] to come.
wb/40/12.33: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by [its] fruit.
wb/40/12.34: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaketh.
wb/40/12.35: A good man, out of the good treasure of the heart, bringeth forth good things: and an evil man, out of the evil treasure, bringeth forth evil things.
wb/40/12.36: But I say to you, That for every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account in the day of judgment.
wb/40/12.37: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
wb/40/12.38: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
wb/40/12.39: But he answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh for a sign, and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah.
wb/40/12.4: How he entered into the house of God, and ate the show-bread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them who were with him, but only for the priests?
wb/40/12.40: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the whale's belly: so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
wb/40/12.41: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah [is] here.
wb/40/12.42: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon [is] here.
wb/40/12.43: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and he findeth none.
wb/40/12.44: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth [it] empty, swept, and garnished.
wb/40/12.45: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last [state] of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also to this wicked generation.
wb/40/12.46: While he was yet speaking to the people, behold, [his] mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
wb/40/12.47: Then one said to him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
wb/40/12.48: But he answered and said to him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
wb/40/12.49: And he stretched forth his hand towards his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
wb/40/12.5: Or have ye not read in the law, that on the sabbath the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
wb/40/12.50: For whoever shall do the will of my Father who is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
wb/40/12.6: But I say to you, that in this place is [one] greater than the temple.
wb/40/12.7: But if ye had known what [this] meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
wb/40/12.8: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath.
wb/40/12.9: And when he had departed thence, he went into their synagogue.

wb/40/6.1: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen by them: otherwise ye have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
wb/40/6.10: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as [it is] in heaven.
wb/40/6.11: Give us this day our daily bread.
wb/40/6.12: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
wb/40/6.13: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

wb/40/6.15: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
wb/40/6.16: Moreover, when ye fast, be not as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear to men to fast. Verily, I say to you, they have their reward.
wb/40/6.17: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thy head, and wash thy face;
wb/40/6.18: That thou mayest not appear to men to fast, but to thy Father, who is in secret: and thy Father, who seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
wb/40/6.19: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
wb/40/6.2: Therefore, when thou doest [thy] alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do, in the synagogues, and in the streets, that they may have glory from men. Verily, I say to you, they have their reward.
wb/40/6.20: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal.
wb/40/6.21: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
wb/40/6.22: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thy eye be single, thy whole body will be full of light.
wb/40/6.23: But if thy eye be evil, thy whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee is darkness, how great [is] that darkness!

wb/40/6.26: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
wb/40/6.27: Which of you by anxious care can add one cubit to his stature?
wb/40/6.28: And why are ye anxious for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field how they grow? they toil not, neither do they spin?
wb/40/6.29: And yet I say to you, that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
wb/40/6.3: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
wb/40/6.30: Wherefore, if God so clotheth the grass of the field, which to-day is, and to-morrow is cast into the oven, [will he] not much more [clothe] you, O ye of little faith?
wb/40/6.31: Therefore be not anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or what shall we drink? or, with what shall we be clothed?
wb/40/6.32: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
wb/40/6.33: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness, and all these things shall be added to you.
wb/40/6.34: Therefore be not anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be solicitous for the things of itself. Sufficient to the day [is] its own evil.
wb/40/6.4: That thy alms may be in secret; and thy Father who seeth in secret, himself will reward thee openly.
wb/40/6.5: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites [are]: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues, and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Verily, I say to you, they have their reward.
wb/40/6.6: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret, will reward thee openly.

wb/40/6.8: Therefore be ye not like them: for your Father knoweth what things ye need before ye ask him.
wb/40/6.9: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

web/1/3.1: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden?’”
web/1/3.10: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”

web/60/1.22: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently:
web/60/1.23: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
web/60/1.24: For,  “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
web/60/1.25: but the Lord’s word endures forever.”    This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
web/60/1.3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
web/60/1.4: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
web/60/1.5: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
web/60/1.6: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,
web/60/1.7: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

ylt/2/24.1: And unto Moses He said, `Come up unto Jehovah, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and ye have bowed yourselves afar off;'
ylt/2/24.10: and they see the God of Israel, and under His feet <FI>is<Fi> as the white work of the sapphire, and as the substance of the heavens for purity;
ylt/2/24.11: and unto those of the sons of Israel who are near He hath not put forth His hand, and they see God, and eat and drink.
ylt/2/24.12: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Come up unto Me to the mount, and be there, and I give to thee the tables of stone, and the law, and the command, which I have written to direct them.'
ylt/2/24.13: And Moses riseth--Joshua his minister also--and Moses goeth up unto the mount of God;
ylt/2/24.14: and unto the elders he hath said, `Abide ye for us in this <FI>place<Fi> , until that we turn back unto you, and lo, Aaron and Hur <FI>are<Fi> with you--he who hath matters doth come nigh unto them.'
ylt/2/24.15: And Moses goeth up unto the mount, and the cloud covereth the mount;
ylt/2/24.16: and the honour of Jehovah doth tabernacle on mount Sinai, and the cloud covereth it six days, and He calleth unto Moses on the seventh day from the midst of the cloud.
ylt/2/24.17: And the appearance of the honour of Jehovah <FI>is<Fi> as a consuming fire on the top of the mount, before the eyes of the sons of Israel;
ylt/2/24.18: and Moses goeth into the midst of the cloud, and goeth up unto the mount, and Moses is on the mount forty days and forty nights.
ylt/2/24.2: and Moses hath drawn nigh by himself unto Jehovah; and they draw not nigh, and the people go not up with him.
ylt/2/24.3: And Moses cometh in, and recounteth to the people all the words of Jehovah, and all the judgments, and all the people answer--one voice, and say, `All the words which Jehovah hath spoken we do.'
ylt/2/24.4: And Moses writeth all the words of Jehovah, and riseth early in the morning, and buildeth an altar under the hill, and twelve standing pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel;
ylt/2/24.5: and he sendeth the youths of the sons of Israel, and they cause burnt-offerings to ascend, and sacrifice sacrifices of peace-offerings to Jehovah--calves.
ylt/2/24.6: And Moses taketh half of the blood, and putteth in basins, and half of the blood hath he sprinkled on the altar;
ylt/2/24.7: and he taketh the Book of the Covenant, and proclaimeth in the ears of the people, and they say, `All that which Jehovah hath spoken we do, and obey.'
ylt/2/24.8: And Moses taketh the blood, and sprinkleth on the people, and saith, `Lo, the blood of the covenant which Jehovah hath made with you, concerning all these things.'
